cohort: 500 pregnant mothers attending antenatal clinic at Calcutta National Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata
finding: Hypothyroid mothers had significantly higher rates of preeclampsia, preterm labor, intrauterine growth restriction, cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and low birth weight babies with lower Apgar scores compared to euthyroid mothers.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in hypothyroid mothers (50%) compared to euthyroid mothers (20.9%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was defined as <2.5kg.
